title: A bare SUM in a FILTER predicate is the grand total, so the rows are compared with the total
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Sales[ProductKey] ), "S", [Sales Amount] ), [S] >= SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) * 0.5 )

source.quote: in order to avoid the implicit context transition
source.supports: the article's corrected query uses SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) in the FILTER condition so the comparison is with the total of all products

derivation: S per ProductKey: 1: 400, 2: 60, 3: 80. SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) has no CALCULATE around it, so it is the grand total 540 on every row; 540 * 0.5 = 270. Only 400 >= 270.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
